about: Warning: OVRDARK is an intense virtual reality game that may cause dizziness or discomfort in some individuals.
It is strongly recommended that players take regular breaks during the gaming session to prevent visual fatigue and potential adverse effects.

If you experience dizziness, nausea, or discomfort, it is advised to immediately stop playing and take a rest. The health and well-being of players are of utmost importance. Play responsibly and enjoy OVRDARK safely!
Immerse yourself in the chilling and exclusive virtual reality sequel to "DO NOT OPEN".
Get ready to experience an even more terrifying journey in "OVRDARK", where horror and tension reach new heights as you explore the cursed mansion of Burkittsville in full immersion.
"OVRDARK" is the sequel to the acclaimed game "DO NOT OPEN", taking the series to new horrors and challenges in the world of virtual reality.
summary: Dive in the dark and seek the truth.
